description: Creates or recovers an ArisPay account for delegated custody and provisions a USDC payer wallet in one call (side effects: registers the email, creates a Coinbase CDP-managed wallet, writes credentials to ~/.payagent/config.json on this machine). Moves no money — it does NOT spend funds. Idempotent: re-running with the same email recovers the existing account and its wallets. Not needed in self-custody mode: if PAYAGENT_PRIVATE_KEY is set, skip setup entirely — pay works with the local key alone.

email.description: Email to register the account under. It is also the recovery key — use a real address.

name.description: Human name. Falls back to the email local-part.

name: setup
